description: Internal notes on one conversation, named by id; the customer does not see them. action list returns the notes one page at a time. action add writes a note (body, with mentions as a list of usr_ ids of members to notify). action edit changes a note’s body (noteId and body; only its author can). action delete removes a note (noteId; its author, an owner or an admin can). Deleting acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it deletes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes. Notes can quote customers and come back marked untrusted.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

noteId.description: The noteId in the resource path.

name: chat_notes
title: Internal notes on a chat
